rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an outward assurance, promise, or guarantee intended to reassure someone.

example.english: I give you assurance that I’ll pay you back tomorrow.
example.jyutping: ngo5 bou2 zing3 teng1 jat6 jat1 ding6 waan4 cin2

rows.note: Use this when assurance means inner confidence, trust, or freedom from doubt rather than an outward guarantee.

example.english: I have complete assurance about this decision.
example.traditional: 我對呢個決定好有信心。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 hou2 jau5 seon3 sam1

rows.note: Use this specifically for confidence in oneself, especially firm self-confidence or poise.

example.english: Before going on stage, I need more assurance in myself.
example.traditional: 上台之前，我要對自己有多啲自信。
example.jyutping: soeng6 toi4 zi1 cin4 ngo5 jiu3 deoi3 zi6 gei2 jau5 do1 di1 zi6 seon3

rows.note: Use this only for the negative sense of impudent, shameless boldness or cheek.

example.english: They’re really shameless; they have the assurance to ask me for another loan after already borrowing money.
example.traditional: 佢真係厚面皮，借完錢仲夠膽問我可唔可以再借。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hau5 min6 pei4 ze3 jyun4 cin2 zung6 gau3 daam2 man6 ngo5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 zoi3 ze3
